title: Aggregation
description: Components combined into a kit or system - a hip implant's stem, head and cup; or sub-assemblies into a finished imaging system. The subject of the entry is the parent unit; the components are listed in children.

container.description: The container itself, e.g. the implant system or the finished scanner.

children.description: The units contained. The upper limit matches core.MaxParents: more than a thousand components in one step is no longer a real event.
